description.html: This round dish with Aztec patterns looks like a piece of old carved stone. A row of relief panels with symbols runs around the wide rim, and the center has a hollow for water or food. The grey-beige color with darker shading in the recesses gives the impression of an ancient artifact found in a jungle or desert.

This dish is the right choice if you decorate your terrarium around a theme, for example temple ruins with plants, roots and rocks. It pairs well with our Aztec calendar hide, so the two pieces work together as a set.
The wide rim is also practical: the dish has a large footprint and stands firmly, and your animal can rest its front legs on the edge while drinking. The relief gives claws a good grip.

Because of the relief, food leftovers and limescale collect in the grooves, so scrub the dish with a soft brush once a week. Change the water every day. If you use the dish as a feeder, remove leftover fruit or vegetables the same day.
